systems.system: Projet d'appui aux fondations de l'économie numérique (PAFEN)
systems.owner: Government of Burundi with World Bank financing of USD 92 million
systems.tiers: national; launched 2024, 61% of budget committed at the March 2026 mid-term review, target 2028

note: PAFEN is called a pillar of a 'digital transformation strategy' that the article does not name or describe; the government's framework named is Vision 2040-2060 (development-plan).
